product_desc: turns a household's receipts into a clear monthly spending report
headline: Your Spending. Explained.
content_recipe: the full report is the HERO, held by human hands (hands only, no full person or face), surrounded by floating glass panels that EXPLAIN the numbers (a score with a red/yellow/green status ring, category cards with colored status dots, a small trend line-graph, a horizontal budget gauge bar, an alert chip, and a plain-language insight line), plus subtle financial accents. Convey that a number alone is not enough.
rules: Sophisticated, gallery-grade, art-directed, high craft. Flat full-bleed desktop homepage, not in a device frame. AVOID generic AI SaaS boilerplate and lifestyle/interior stock photography. Only headline text legible.
